HINTRITARDOCAMBIO.eng: Management of the petrol-gas switch delay is based on the engine water temperature. \\nIt can be detected by the sensor on the reducer heating pipe or directly on the original sensor of the engine. \\nThis delay can be managed by a string in which it is possible to associate a delay time with each given temperature. \\nThe ECU detects the instantaneous water temperature with the ignition on, enabling the petrol-gas switch when the set delay has elapsed and the conditions on the type of switch and on the revs threshold are verified
HINTRITARDOCAMBIO.ita: La gestione del ritardo per il passaggio benzina-gas avviene in base alla temperatura del liquido raffreddamento motore del veicolo. \\nEssa puÃ² essere rilevata dal sensore presente sul tubo riscaldamento del riduttore o direttamente sul sensore originale del motore. \\nTale ritardo Ã¨ gestibile per mezzo di una stringa in cui Ã¨ possibile associare a ciascuna determinata temperatura un tempo di ritardo. \\nLa ECU rileva al sottochiave la temperatura acqua istantanea abilitando il passaggio benzina-gas una volta che sia trascorso \\nil ritardo impostato e siano verificate le condizioni sul tipo di passaggio e sulla soglia giri.
HINTRITARDOCAMBIO.por: Management of the petrol-gas switch delay is based on the engine water temperature. \\nIt can be detected by the sensor on the reducer heating pipe or directly on the original sensor of the engine. \\nThis delay can be managed by a string in which it is possible to associate a delay time with each given temperature. \\nThe ECU detects the instantaneous water temperature with the ignition on, enabling the petrol-gas switch when the set delay has elapsed and the conditions on the type of switch and on the revs threshold are verified

HINTRITARDOCAMBIOGAS.eng: If the T-water sensor is not used, gas mode switchover is based on initial gas temperature and time delay from engine starting. \\nIn the table, for each gas temperature value should be set proper time delay, to obtain normal reducer pre-heating. \\nThe ECU detects the instantaneous gas temperature with the ignition on, enabling the petrol-gas switch once that the set delay has elapsed and the conditions on the type of switch and on the revs threshold are verified
HINTRITARDOCAMBIOGAS.ita: Nel caso in cui il sensore acqua non sia collegato la gestione del ritardo per il passaggio benzina-gas \\navviene in base alla temperatura del gas rilevata dal sensore gas presente sul rail iniettori.\\nLa ECU rileva al sottochiave la temperatura gas istantanea abilitando il passaggio benzina-gas una volta che sia trascorso \\nil ritardo impostato e siano verificate le condizioni sul tipo di passaggio e sulla soglia giri.
HINTRITARDOCAMBIOGAS.por: If the T-water sensor is not used, gas mode switchover is based on initial gas temperature and time delay from engine starting. \\nIn the table, for each gas temperature value should be set proper time delay, to obtain normal reducer pre-heating. \\nThe ECU detects the instantaneous gas temperature with the ignition on, enabling the petrol-gas switch once that the set delay has elapsed and the conditions on the type of switch and on the revs threshold are verified
